subject.title: Bug: Matrix room agents can loop on visible no-reply output, restart recovery, and stale session replay

question: Should OpenClaw treat Matrix bot-to-bot rooms as an explicitly supported workflow with bounded automatic loop suppression, or make group bot traffic fail closed unless deliberately configured and documented?
rationale: The report mixes a possible regression with requested policy and operator-surface changes; the correct default for legitimate multi-agent rooms versus strict safety cannot be inferred from the incident narrative alone.

options.title: Support controlled bot-to-bot rooms
options.body: Keep explicit Matrix bot-to-bot participation, but require one centrally tested guard covering ingress, silent delivery, and restart recovery.

options.title: Fail closed by default
options.body: Disable bot-authored Matrix room admission except for a narrowly documented opt-in while a replay-safe design is completed.

options.title: Limit this issue to a regression
options.body: First reproduce a concrete bypass and defer broader health and session-management product additions to separate proposals.

recommendation.title: Support controlled bot-to-bot rooms
recommendation.body: Keep explicit Matrix bot-to-bot participation, but require one centrally tested guard covering ingress, silent delivery, and restart recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent adjacent gateway/session and channel work provides the best available low-confidence routing signal for the policy decision.
